description: Resolved upstream and reference revisions, toolchain pins and container digests wiliwili-NS2 builds against. Every pin is exact; nothing floats.

integrated.subject: Fix followed-UP list parsing in Dynamic (#710)
integrated.note: Whole commit: DynamicUpResult::mid is a string and is converted where it is fired on the event bus.

integrated.subject: fix(player): make progress slider pointer follow drag gesture
integrated.note: Whole commit: the progress pointer keeps following the drag instead of snapping back.

integrated.subject: refactor: reuse HTTP::createSession for image requests
integrated.note: Whole commit: image requests share the HTTP session setup and its proxy/TLS handling.

integrated.subject: chore(build): disable unity build and bump deps
integrated.note: Shared parts only: cmake/FindMPV.cmake (drop the Homebrew mpv-wiliwili probe, dedupe the pkg-config library list) and the TRIMUI guards in activity_helper.hpp, setting_activity.cpp and config_helper.cpp. Its CI, Flatpak, macOS bundle, Switch 1 BUILTIN_NSP script, font and mbedtls curl backend changes are not taken.

skipped.subject: Migrate D3D11 video rendering to mpv's new D3D11 render API (#697)
skipped.reason: Windows D3D11 render path only; this port uses EGL/GLES through OunceVK.

borealis.note: Reference snapshot of the UI framework branch. The gitlink is pinned separately to dd652691 for upstream's nlohmann/json 3.12.0 upgrade and i18n literal syntax fix; the Switch 2 backends remain outside the submodule (ADR 0005).

openblops_nx.note: Reference for PadPointer/Nmouse button arbitration only. No DXVK or Direct3D layer is imported.

ounce_devkit.note: The install.sh whose signing key fingerprint and pacman recipe scripts/switch2/Dockerfile reproduces.

libounce.note: VideoDecoder (nx/include/switch2/video/decoder.h, nx/source/switch2/video/decoder.c) inspected at 03af07a7; identical VideoDecoder ABI in packaged 20261117.1-1 (32e7ac41).

kaitube.note: Reference for redirecting Switch 1 devkitPro portlib paths to libounce and portlibs/switch2 on Switch 2.

mpv.note: vd_lavc.c (v0.36.0) exposes AV_CODEC_CAP_HARDWARE + wrapper_name="ounce" as hwdec=ounce-copy without an mpv patch. mpv's public render.h still has no merged caller-owned Vulkan render API, so the port keeps MPVCore's OpenGL/EGL framebuffer path.

mpv_build.note: Authoritative Switch portlib recipe for FFmpeg 7.1.5 and libmpv 0.36.0.

ffmpeg.note: v4l2_m2m_dec.c, mediacodecdec.c, codec_internal.h, allcodecs.c inspected as primary templates for the Switch 2 FFmpeg ounce wrapper.

kaivideo.note: Reference for VideoDecoder config, 1088 coded height, >1080p H.264/VP9 software routing (source/swframe.c), timestamps, and bounded copy.

moonlight_switch.note: Reference for native frame ownership, deferred retirement, and Stage 3 VK_EXT_external_memory_host + GSV GPU sharing (#22).

borealis_vulkan.note: Native Vulkan Borealis backend reference for Stage 3 evaluation (#22).

nanovg_vulkan.status: not reachable (HTTP 404 on GitHub on 2026-11-23); no Vulkan nanovg backend is imported

hblist.note: Homebrew listing the NS2 NRO is added to by hand; the port does not depend on it.

graphics.backend: OunceVK: Mesa NVK (Vulkan 1.4) and Zink (EGL, OpenGL, OpenGL ES 3.1) in $DEVKITPRO/portlibs/switch2
graphics.notes: OunceVK also installs empty libGLESv2.a, libglapi.a and libdrm_nouveau.a stubs in portlibs/switch2 so the Switch 1 copies in portlibs/switch can never be linked by mistake.
